definitions.en: n strips of potato fried in deep fat

examples.en: I ordered fish and chips for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐点了炸鱼和薯条。

examples.en: He used wooden chips for the fire.

examples.zh: 海关官员仔细检查了我们的行李。

definitions.en: n the federal department responsible for maintaining a national energy policy of the United States; created in 1977
definitions.zh: v. 做；工作；有用（do的第三人称单数形式）

examples.en: She does her homework every evening.
He does a great job at work.

definitions.en: n a digital recording (as of a movie) on an optical disk that can be played on a computer or a television set
definitions.zh: abbr. 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）

examples.en: I watch a DVD every weekend.
This DVD has my favorite movie.
examples.zh: 这张DVD有我最喜欢的电影。

definitions.en: n a parent of your father or mother
definitions.zh: n. 外祖父母；祖父母（grandparent的复数）

We visit our grandparents every weekend.
examples.zh: 我们每个周末都去看望祖父母。

definitions.zh: n. 手推车,手推运货车

definitions.en: n. the most recent news or development

examples.zh: 她总是穿最新潮的时装。

definitions.en: n a form of address for a man
definitions.zh: 阁下, 先生

definitions.en: n a form of address for a woman

examples.zh: 会议后将提供简单的茶点。

examples.zh: 我们在休息时享用了点心。

definitions.en: n the act of putting something in working order again
definitions.zh: n. 备件；修理；修理费；修理工作（repair的复数形式）

examples.zh: 他按时完成了修理工作。

definitions.en: n. a bag for carrying school books and supplies

examples.zh: 我的书包是蓝色的，很重。

examples.zh: 这些纪念品让我想起我的旅行。
